description: score_lead needs the right lead resolved from a partial name (icp.find fuzzy match); start_sequence needs the correct sequence key matching what actually happened to the lead; propose_meeting needs the right lead and a real time slot, not a placeholder.

cases.rubric: Correctly resolves the partial name 'Helio' to the real lead Helio Freight (LEAD-1001) and scores that specific lead, rather than asking for clarification unnecessarily or scoring the wrong/no lead.

cases.message: Castille started a trial and went quiet, chase it
cases.rubric: Starts the trial-activation-type sequence (re-engaging a stalled trial), not the inbound-demo sequence meant for a fresh demo request — the sequence type matches the actual situation described.

cases.message: Helio Freight want a call next week, get it booked
cases.rubric: Resolves Helio Freight to the correct lead, proposes a meeting with a real time slot rather than a placeholder, and does not confuse this with starting a new outreach sequence when a meeting was explicitly requested.
